statements.status_notes: CVE-2008-1687: the maketemp and mkstemp builtins in GNU m4 before 1.4.11 returned the created file name unquoted, so a generated name that happened to match a defined macro could be expanded and the wrong file used. GNU m4 fixed this in 1.4.11 by quoting the builtins' output (upstream commit 'Minor security fix: Quote output of mkstemp.', https://lists.libreplanet.org/archive/html/m4-commit/2007-12/msg00011.html, recorded in the 1.4.11 entry of the m4 NEWS file). This package is built from upstream m4 1.4.19, whose src/builtin.c mkstemp_helper wraps the generated name in the current quote delimiters (https://sources.debian.org/src/m4/1.4.19-8/src/builtin.c/). Every published build of this package is based on 1.4.19 and contains the fix; the range boundary is the currently published package version. Debian's tracker records no fixed version because it rates the issue unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2008-1687).
